notes: ROUND 2 (re-verification after tool fix + mapping-A update): all 21 non-CONFIRMED claims and all 6 non-CONFIRMED field items re-checked against the current `node tools/claims.mjs 0009_LeumiFile-BY mapping-A.json` (+ --fields) output and the code -> all FIXED. 14 new spot-checks (SC-*) on declaredRowFilters / recordKeyColumns / declaredSources and on the tool-computed per-writer rowFilters: 11 CONFIRMED, 1 WRONG (false-positive row filters), 2 INCOMPLETE (row-filter polarity/attribution; Maslulim Merge Join/Sort filters not structured). The round-1 notes below describe the state before the fix.

ROOT CAUSE of most WRONG verdicts (tool, not analyst JSON): tools/lineage.mjs:148-149 stores scriptOutputs.from[].role on script-code nodes, but lineage.mjs:250 builds node.origin = s.from.map(...) without the role, and compose.mjs:50 / lineage.mjs:268 follow n.origin with the PARENT role. Every input that the analyst declared role 'condition' on a resolved script output (Convert Data Types, Convert gen_isActive, Compare Fields Before Update) is therefore printed as VALUE in the claims. mapping-A.json itself has the correct roles. Fixing the tool (propagate 'influence' for condition/key roles) would turn the 17 WRONG claims into correct ones; the attribute-level facts below must still be re-checked after the fix.

Copies verified: SDK Create (outside) 1-5 main.cs sha 018b435872df and identical input lists; Create Annotation 1-5 sha c872f18903c1; Maslulim SDK Create 1-5 sha f575e09a3041; Update TransferIn 2/3/4/5 sha 824c90373700, Update TransferIn 1 sha 7bf44029d7f8 (whitespace only at main.cs 128/153/170); Update 1 and 2 have the extra unused input ProcessNumber. Functional behaviour of all Update versions is identical, so Update 1/2/3 get identical verdicts.

Chain-order cosmetic issue (not a verdict driver): Maslulim chains print 'Trim All Input Columns' before 'Childe Saving handel', but the real order is Read BY Data From Staging -> Childe Saving handel -> Set Task Name Variable -> Multicast -> Trim All Input Columns (paths in the Maslulim data flow). The RWM text itself correctly says 'runs before Trim'.

Runtime-semantics consistency: the analyst applies PipelineBuffer ColumnIsNullException semantics to Update TransferIn (FINDING 2) but scriptOutputs for 'Convert gen_isActive from char to int' says NULL Is_Active_92 -> gen_IsActive NULL. By the same semantics string.IsNullOrEmpty(Row.IsActive92) (main.cs:121, DTSX 87394) throws on a NULL column with no try/catch (data-flow failure). Practically only '' reaches it (Trim keeps ''), so it does not change a mapping, but the statement should be aligned.

No missing CRM writes found: the only CRM writers in the two data flows are SDK Create gen_TransferIn 1-5 (outside source), Update TransferIn 1-5, Create Annotation 1-5 and Maslulim SDK Create gen_TransferIn 1-5; all attributes they set (26 / 10 / 4 / 12) are covered and none is invented.
